qa_pairs.question: How do Statutory Regulatory Orders (SROs) define their operational lifespan and effective date under current legal practice?
qa_pairs.answer: SROs define their operational lifespan by specifying both a commencement date and an expiry date, such as in [0] and [1], where the SROs are effective from June 6, 2024, and remain valid until June 30, 2025, and June 30, 2028, respectively. Alternatively, SROs may be issued with a retrospective effective date, as shown in [2], [3], [4], [5], [6], and [7], which are deemed to have been effective from June 6, 2024.
